integrity.claim_evidence: A complete shape classification, two-direction forcing construction, labelled interval count, coefficient-difference proof and sharp log-concavity counterinequality are given in RESULT.md.
integrity.standalone_check: VERIFY.py, standard-library Python, checks all 46,608 subsets in 34 graphs and 1,680 coefficient-shape parameter cases.
integrity.unproved_extensions: No claims concerning arbitrary multi-leaf unicyclic graphs or real-rootedness.

scientific_limitations: Only connected unicyclic graphs with exactly one pendant vertex are covered.
Unimodality and log-concavity refer to the nonzero coefficient string, not to all unicyclic graphs.
The work is mathematically proved and computationally cross-checked but has no independent expert or formal audit.
Historical priority beyond accessible indexed records remains provisional.
title: Connected zero-forcing polynomials of one-leaf unicyclic graphs
